title: SheetStore - Data & Sheet Analytics Platform
problem: Teams and businesses need a centralized cloud platform to manage, query, store, and analyze spreadsheet data efficiently.
approach: Built and deployed SheetStore on Vercel. Engineered a responsive web application allowing users to upload, query, analyze, and manage sheet data with real-time dashboards and API pipelines.
insights: Streamlined spreadsheet workflows into a fast, accessible cloud data platform.

title: Google Looker Studio BI Dashboard
problem: Executive leadership required real-time, interactive KPI tracking and cross-channel performance analytics.
approach: Designed and published an interactive dashboard on Google Looker Studio with dynamic date slicers, real-time metrics, regional revenue breakdown, and automated data updates.
insights: Unlocked real-time decision making with live embedded reporting.

title: UIDAI Data Hackathon–2026
problem: Identify high-load regions and infrastructure pressure zones using demographic and biometric data.
approach: Processed 4.9M records using Pandas. Engineered features including enrollment/update totals and district-level update ratios. Performed age-group segmentation (0–5, 5–17, 18+). Built visualizations using Matplotlib.
insights: Highlighted top states and districts by enrollment and update activity.

title: E-commerce Funnel & Revenue Leakage Analysis
problem: Where are users dropping off before purchase?
approach: Analyzed funnel stages (visit → add to cart → checkout → payment). Wrote advanced SQL queries using JOINs, CTEs, Window Functions, and conducted cohort analysis to identify drop-offs and revenue loss.
insights: Checkout page causes 35% drop → fix UX

title: Sales Performance Dashboard (Executive Level)
problem: Business leaders need quick decisions from data.
approach: Built interactive dashboard with KPI cards (Revenue, Profit, Growth %), Region-wise performance, Product category trends, and Time-series (monthly sales). Included DAX measures (YoY growth, moving average), drill-down, and slicers.
insights: North region underperforming by 18%. Top 20% products drive 80% revenue.
